name: tinysheet
description: A lightweight spreadsheet built with TypeScript and Electron

scripts.build:main: tsc --ignoreConfig electron/main.ts --outDir electron --target ES2020 --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution bundler && tsc --ignoreConfig src/preload.ts --outDir src --target ES2020 --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution bundler
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win
